## Problem
On a host reached via `DREAMCONNECT_SKIP_DEPS=1` (or an unrecognised package manager, `install.sh:356` `DEPS=()`), python3 may be absent when `wait_for_user_bus` runs. The connect probe then fails identically to a bus that is not up, so a perfectly healthy user bus burns the full 30s and aborts the install with "the user bus … never came up" — pointing the operator at `user@<uid>.service` when the real fault is a missing interpreter.
